jobs.title: Union Relations Lead / Directeur(rice) du Paritarisme
jobs.description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. jobs.description: About Solace Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes. We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly. Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way. Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here . About the Role We're looking for a Trust & Integrity Specialist to protect the integrity of the patient experience and the Solace platform. Sitting within the Customer Experience team, you'll serve as a dedicated resource for identifying, investigating, and resolving situations that pose risk to the patient or advocate experience. This role sits at the intersection of patient safety, conduct oversight, and operational risk. You'll own the review of flagged cases, monitor for emerging patterns, manage complaints with care and urgency, and ensure that the people and systems patients interact with are operating within Solace's protocols and standards. Reporting to the T&I Manager, you'll work closely with QA, operations, and internal stakeholders to maintain a trustworthy, safe, and high-quality experience for every patient we serve. Today this work centers on advocate-facing cases; as Trust & Integrity expands, the same function will extend to other patient-facing groups (CX, physicians, and beyond). jobs.title: Co-Founder & CTO (gn), Industrial Data for AI, Paris
jobs.description: About FoodLabs FoodLabs is Europe's leading early-stage VC and venture studio, backing founders who are shaping the future of the food, health, and climate value chains. We build companies from zero, putting capital, our own team, and hands-on operating time behind a founding team before there's a product or even a name. The studio's work spans wherever a market and the data or infrastructure underneath it are broken enough to justify building the fix from scratch. About The General Data Corporation General Data is the infrastructure for licensing proprietary data: The platform runs the whole deal from request to delivery, with privacy checks, rights evidence and contracts built in. The vision is to become the system of record between AI and the world’s private data, the data that has never been published but that the next generation of AI depends on. On one side are enterprises, AI labs and robotics teams that need real-world data, and on the other are companies whose operations generate it. General Data is the data infrastructure for the modern economy, connecting every party so that data can be licensed safely, transparently and at scale. Why this is a unique opportunity AI has absorbed the public internet, and its next gains will come from private, real-world data, yet today these deals still run on email, WhatsApp and brokers, with no visibility into what was checked, who holds the rights, or whether personal data was removed. Labs are already paying for this data, and regulation like GDPR and the EU Data Act makes a trusted, verifiable layer a necessity. General Data is VC-backed and looking for its technical co-founder. Together with Founder & CEO Louai Allani , you will own the product and architecture, shape the company’s direction as an equal partner and build the team from the ground up. Alan est né pour changer ça — en combinant assurance santé et clinique virtuelle dans une seule application pour devenir un vrai partenaire santé . L'optique est au cœur de la promesse d’Alan "La santé ne peut pas attendre". Avec l 'Alan Shop , nos membres achètent lunettes et lentilles de contact depuis l'application ; avec notre réseau d'opticiens partenaires , ils sont mieux remboursés en magasin ; et nos équipes Fraude veillent à ce que chaque euro remboursé le soit à bon escient. Nous avons prouvé qu'une assurance santé pouvait vendre de l'optique en ligne. Nous voulons maintenant passer à l'échelle, avec un·e opticien·ne supplémentaire dans l'équipe. Ce que nous recherchons Ce opticien·ne diplômé·e, à l'aise avec le conseil à distance et motivé·e pour rejoindre l'équipe d'opticiens prenant en charge les différentes missions autours de l'optique d'Alan Shop. Les missions : Chat optique. Répondre à nos membres sur l'application (choix de monture, lecture d'ordonnance, verres, lentilles, questions d'optique au sens large), avec le ton Alan : clair, bienveillant, personnalisé. Validation des commandes de lentilles de contact. Contrôler les ordonnances que notre outil automatique ne peut pas valider, et signaler les suspicions de fraude (dates modifiées, documents falsifiés) à notre équipe dédiée. « Mon Opticien au Travail ». Animer des journées de conseil et de vente sur site chez nos entreprises clientes, sur la France entière et en priorité en Île-de-France : accueil des salariés, conseil visagiste, prise de mesures, aide au choix de la monture. Amélioration continue. Answer queries and provide complete and accurate product information and benefits carried by the Company. Generate sales and assist in retail operations management. Perform other administrative tasks that may be assigned by the Store Executive. Participates in all improvement and engagement programs and initiatives implemented in the store. Why Join Us? Experience on-the-job skill development and mentoring program. Learn from our in-house and external trainings. Grow and challenge yourself to join our leadership development program. Work in a Company that values an entrepreneurial mindset on the job. Feel secure in our above industry compensation package. Join an organization that has a high retention rate, where people love where they work.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description: You will play a pivotal role in our journey to transform healthcare in the Philippines. Your primary mission will be to ensure unparalleled customer satisfaction and service excellence. This is not just about managing products; it's about leading innovation in a sector that impacts everyone's lives. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to envision, develop, and execute strategies that push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare technology. Product Vision and Strategy Contribute to and help articulate a compelling product vision and strategy that aligns seamlessly with the company's overarching goals. Identify market opportunities and consumer needs to guide product development. Assist in driving the product roadmap, ensuring it aligns with business objectives and market demands. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, marketing, and sales, to ensure smooth product development and launch. Facilitate effective communication and collaboration among team members to achieve product goals. Product Development and Lifecycle Management Oversee aspects of the product lifecycle from ideation to launch and post-launch optimization. Implement best practices for product development, including agile methodologies, user-centered design, and data-driven decision-making. Ensure the timely delivery of high-quality products that meet user expectations and business objectives. User Experience and Design Champion the user experience, ensuring our products are intuitive, engaging, and delightful to use. Collaborate with design and UX teams to create user-centered designs that solve real problems and drive engagement. Data-Driven Decision Making Utilize analytics and user feedback to inform product decisions and prioritize features.
